style.styleTitle: Personalised Fa La La Glass Bauble by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: Add a sparkling touch to your Christmas tree with this Personalised Fa La La Glass Bauble. Featuring a festive “Fa La La” design, this elegant glass Christmas decoration can be personalised with 3 lines of up to 15 characters each, making it a thoughtful keepsake or unique festive gift. Perfect for adding a personal touch to your seasonal décor, this personalised bauble is sure to become a treasured part of your Christmas celebrations year after year. Dimensions (mm). Height: 75. Width: 130. Depth: 75.
